feed.title: VanEck to shutter Ethereum futures ETF
feed.summary: VanEck is closing its futures-based Ethereum ETF (EFUT) due to insufficient demand, low assets under management, and dominant inflows into spot cryptocurrency ETFs. The fund, launched in 2023, will cease trading on September 16, with assets liquidated by September 23. This decision supports analyst predictions that spot crypto ETFs would make futures-based ones obsolete, as VanEck's own spot Ethereum ETF (ETHV) has significantly higher AUM.
